review_description: Alex Briers is a very qualified young man who came to talk to us quietly about (a) what we wanted to achieve Nag (b) how he could provide that.  He is the involved head of his company not some salesman employed to get a quick sale.  He offers excellent product at a very reasonable price.  He can supply anything of any quality you desire but recommends the better quality all the time.  He should be on your list of suppliers as the ones you suggested all came from Brisbane or the Gold Coast.  Toowoomba is a major supply hub for farmers and townsfolk from here to the west and also north & south of here.
